    Research & Innovation

    Drives the college's research agenda in alignment with Education 5.0. Oversees Theory of Education, Professional Foundations, Teaching Practice, Distance Education and the In-Service Programme.

    Visit Research Portal View All Departments
    Department of Research & Innovation

    Department Overview

    The Department of Research & Innovation is the engine of knowledge creation and dissemination at Morgan Zintec College. It coordinates all research activities, manages the In-Service programme, oversees Teaching Practice, and ensures the college's academic programmes are informed by current research and innovation.

    👤

    [To be updated]

    Head of Department — Research & Innovation

    Theory of Education

    Foundational educational theories, philosophy of education, sociology of education, and psychology of learning applied to Zimbabwean contexts.

    Professional Studies

    Professional Foundations A, B, C, D covering teacher professionalism, ethics, classroom management, assessment, and reflective practice.

    Teaching Practice

    Coordination of school placements, mentor supervision, assessment of practical teaching, and TP portfolio management across all programmes.

    Distance Education

    Flexible learning pathways for in-service teachers, online course delivery, and blended learning programme management.

    In-Service Programme

    Diploma in Supervision & ICT for school-based mentors. 840+ graduates since 2014. Partnership with UNESCO in early years.

    Advancing Education Through Research

    Committed to Education 5.0 — Heritage, Innovation, Industrialization. Generating evidence-based knowledge for Zimbabwe's teacher education sector.
